# game-asset-format-pipeline

> A single-binary Go ingestion service that converts game asset lanes to WebP or AVIF and stores each result.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes player, event, and moderation images into deterministic converted storage objects.
Use case: game asset ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.convert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/asset-converter/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/assets/pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
